node.statement: Smooth graph-atlas upgrade: for every finite-dimensional exact-unit epsilon_r-C*-algebra, if calU is covered by the unique C^1 graph functions g_V of lem-stage1-unitary-graph-control and D_{A^perp} f_V is invertible at every graph point, then those same g_V are C^infinity, and the same graph charts make calU a smooth embedded manifold; no point or first derivative of a graph or chart is changed.
